decisions.reason: The location-based gas tariff comparison remains very close to the firm's core utility-market software and its dedicated web presence indicates continuing commercial relevance.
The regional electricity tariff calculator fits the firm's core tariff and billing capabilities and is likely to stay as a standard component of its platform offering.

The regional energy tariff calculator still supports the firm's platform strategy, but its lower web prominence and overlap with other tariff tools make it more exposed to later portfolio consolidation.

The site-specific energy tariff comparison appears comparatively redundant beside the firm's other tariff calculators and comparison tools, so dropping it would free resources for the core platform and new development.
